visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with a brown hair bun, gold headband, and a floral dress stands in a wide, brightly lit airport terminal. She is looking at a claw machine with interest. The background features white walls, glass railings, and other amusement machines under bright indoor lighting. (2) A close-up view reveals the interior of a claw machine, densely packed with green and brown dinosaur plushies. The lighting inside the machine is vibrant with pink LED accents, highlighting the soft texture and plush material of the toys. (3) The woman, now seen wearing a black coat over her dress, smiles broadly at the camera. Her facial expressions are animated and cheerful. Yellow and white subtitles with black borders are overlaid at the bottom center of the frame. (4) A hand is shown holding several 100-yen coins in front of the claw machine. The woman in the background looks on, her mouth open in a happy expression while watching the process of inserting money. (5) The camera focuses on a person's hand pressing a pink button and moving a joystick on the claw machine console. The woman stands nearby, her hands clutching a passport and documents, looking at the machine with high anticipation. (6) A close-up of a blue and white currency exchange machine is shown. A hand inserts a 1000-yen note into the bill slot. The machine's surface has Japanese text and clear instructional diagrams for the user. (7) The mechanical claw successfully grips a green dinosaur plushie by its neck and lifts it up. The woman is seen in the background, her face lighting up with a wide smile and sparkling eyes as she witnesses success. (8) The woman holds the green dinosaur plushie close to her face, hugging it tightly and kissing it. She is laughing and talking excitedly. The background shows an airport gate area with white seating and shop signage. (9) The woman wears the dinosaur plushie as a backpack, with black straps over her floral dress. She walks away from the camera in a playful runway style, then turns back to laugh, covering her mouth with her hand. (10) A man with short black hair appears in a close-up selfie-style shot at the very end. He is laughing heartily into the camera, with his eyes squinted and mouth wide open, reflecting a moment of joy.

The BGM maintains a steady beat at approximately 115 BPM, providing a consistent cheerful atmosphere. (3) Sharp metallic clinking sounds of coins being handled are heard under the male narration, which remains steady in volume and articulation. (4) The female speaker bursts into loud laughter indicating high arousal. The BGM continues to play without significant spectral changes, matching the joy of the scene. (6) The mechanical whirring of the claw machine's motor is heard, followed by a sudden thump and a triumphant 'Yes!' from the male voice. (7) The female voice becomes very loud and animated, expressing joy with a breathy quality as she reacts to winning. (8) A series of rhythmic 'pop' sound effects accompany the variety-show style text on the screen. The BGM swells slightly in volume, filling the space with warm harmonic textures. (9) The audio concludes with high-energy joint laughter from both speakers, fading out alongside the final guitar chords.
